title: Add handoff package: /images folder, .env file, and README.md

requirements.summary: Create /images folder structure with placeholder images and update all page image references to use relative paths
acceptanceCriteria: A /images (or frontend/public/images) folder exists with placeholder images for the hero banner, each of the 6 service sections, and the About page
All image src attributes in the pages use relative paths pointing to the /images folder
Replacing an image file in /images updates it on the corresponding page without any code changes

file_operations.description: Create the frontend/public/images directory structure to hold all site images. This ensures the folder is tracked in git and establishes the standard location for image assets.

Copy the generated hero banner image from frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png to frontend/public/images/hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png. This establishes the /images folder as the canonical location for site imagery.
Copy the generated .NET service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated Moodle service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-moodle.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-moodle.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated staffing service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-staffing.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-staffing.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated XDT service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-xdt.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-xdt.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated cloud hosting service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-hosting.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-cloud.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated instructional design service image from frontend/public/assets/generated/service-instructional.dim_600x400.png to frontend/public/images/service-design.dim_600x400.png.
Copy the generated About page hero image from frontend/public/assets/generated/about-team.dim_800x500.png to frontend/public/images/about-hero.dim_1200x500.png.

Update all image src attributes in the Home page to reference /images/hero-banner.dim_1440x600.png for the hero section and the corresponding service images (/images/service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png, etc.) in the service cards grid. Use relative paths that work from the public directory.

Update all image src attributes in the Services page to reference the service images from the /images folder (/images/service-dotnet.dim_600x400.png, /images/service-moodle.dim_600x400.png, /images/service-staffing.dim_600x400.png, /images/service-xdt.dim_600x400.png, /images/service-cloud.dim_600x400.png, /images/service-design.dim_600x400.png). Ensure each service section uses the correct relative path.
Update the About page to reference /images/about-hero.dim_1200x500.png for the About page hero visual. Use a relative path that works from the public directory.

requirements.summary: Create .env file with placeholder environment variables for email, reCAPTCHA, and SMTP configuration
acceptanceCriteria: .env file exists at the project root
File contains CONTACT_EMAIL, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD
Each variable has a descriptive placeholder value making its purpose clear

file_operations.description: Create a .env file at the project root containing placeholder environment variables: CONTACT_EMAIL=your@email.com, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY=your-recaptcha-site-key, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY=your-recaptcha-secret-key, SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com, SMTP_PORT=587, SMTP_USERNAME=your-smtp-username, SMTP_PASSWORD=your-smtp-password. Each variable should have a descriptive placeholder that clearly indicates what value should be provided.

requirements.summary: Create comprehensive README.md documenting project structure, environment variables, image replacement, and setup instructions
acceptanceCriteria: README.md exists at the project root
README documents every .env variable with its purpose and an example value
README includes a project structure overview listing all pages and key folders
README contains a note about the HubSpot form placeholder and future replacement of email logic
README provides basic setup instructions including how to replace placeholder images

file_operations.description: Create a comprehensive README.md at the project root that includes: (1) Project overview and description of Brainscribe; (2) Project structure section listing all pages (Home, About, Services, Contact) and key directories (frontend/src/pages, frontend/src/components, frontend/public/images); (3) Environment variables section documenting each .env variable (CONTACT_EMAIL, RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY, RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD) with its purpose and example values; (4) A note explaining that the Contact Us page currently uses a HubSpot form placeholder and will eventually replace any direct email/form logic, but the .env is provided for future flexibility; (5) Local setup instructions including npm install, npm run dev, and deployment steps; (6) Image management section with clear instructions for replacing placeholder images in the frontend/public/images folder, emphasizing that file replacement requires no code changes.
